VALIDATION_FAILED.title: Invalid data
VALIDATION_FAILED.detail: One or more fields failed validation.

UNAUTHORIZED.title: Not authenticated
UNAUTHORIZED.detail: Send a valid API key in the X-API-Key header.

RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.title: Resource not found
RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.detail: The requested route does not exist.

INTERNAL_ERROR.title: Internal error
INTERNAL_ERROR.detail: An unexpected error occurred. Give the correlationId to support.

REPORT_DATE_IN_FUTURE.title: Date in the future
REPORT_DATE_IN_FUTURE.detail: Cannot build the report for {reportDate}, which has not happened yet.

NO_LOG_DATA.title: No log data
NO_LOG_DATA.detail: There are no log events for {reportDate}.

REPORT_ALREADY_DELIVERED.title: Report already delivered
REPORT_ALREADY_DELIVERED.detail: The report for {reportDate} was already sent and cannot change.

REPORT_NOT_SUMMARIZED.title: Report has no summary
REPORT_NOT_SUMMARIZED.detail: Report {id} needs a summary before it can be marked as delivered.

REPORT_VERSION_CONFLICT.title: Version conflict
REPORT_VERSION_CONFLICT.detail: The report was changed by another run (sent version {expected}, current {current}).

FAILURE_WORKFLOW_REQUIRED.title: Workflow required
FAILURE_WORKFLOW_REQUIRED.detail: Send the name of the workflow that failed.
